title: Partial-twuality polynomials of matrices
summary: The study of partial-twuality polynomials originates from the classical operations of geometric duality and Petrie duality on cellularly embedded graphs. These involutions generate the symmetric group $S_3$, and applying them to subsets of edges yields the notions of partial-(geometric) duality, partial-Petriality, and more generally, partial-twuality. In this paper, we generalize this theory of partial-twuality polynomials within the framework of matrix algebra.
